title: $L^p$--$L^q$ estimates for Shimorin-type integral operators
summary: Let $ν$ be a positive measure on $[0,1]$. A Shimorin-type operator $T_ν$ is an integral operator on the unit disk given by \[ T_νf(z) = \int_{\mathbb{D}} \frac{1}{1 - z\overlineλ} \left( \int_0^1 \frac{dν(r)}{1 - r z \overlineλ} \right) f(λ) \, dA(λ), \] which originates from Shimorin's work on Bergman-type kernel representations for logarithmically subharmonic weighted Bergman spaces. In this paper, we study $L^p$--$L^q$ estimates for $T_ν$.
